payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about post-processing approaches used in the translation process, including the restoration of special tokens to their original numerical values.

claims.text: Post-processing includes restoring special tokens <NUMBER> and <DATE> to their original values in the translated sentences.
The post-processing approach also involves detecting and replacing complex patterns like <NUMBER> / <NUMBER> with corresponding numbers from the source sentences.
A rescoring mechanism is used in post-processing to select more fluent translation candidates.
